subject: Request: Special Pilot Rate for Atlas Health — VP/CFO Signoff Needed
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Request: special pilot rate for Atlas Health — details + attachments

Team,

Quick background: Atlas Health (pilot for chronic-care analytics) is asking for a time-limited pilot price that is materially below our published enterprise rate. They want a 6-month pilot with an expected token consumption profile that would equate to ~1.2M tokens/month during peak. If the pilot converts, their forecasted first-year commit could be $480k ARR.

Ask: I need an internal exception memo for VP/CFO signoff to offer a 40% unit-rate discount for the six-month pilot, with the following constraints:
- Pilot term: 6 months only, no automatic conversion
- Success metrics: >= 85% availability and agreed eval prompt set; conversion PO within 30 days of completion
- Billing: monthly in arrears; finance to approve a net-30 invoice cadence (no prepay)

Rationale: strategic vertical reference (healthcare), high visibility if they roll to production, and potential multi-region expansion. We can protect economics with a usage cap and a phased uplift if thresholds are met.

Attached: Atlas_Pilot_SOW_v1.2.pdf, pricing-grid-atlas-spreadsheet.csv (pricing breakdown).

Please review margin impact and we should loop Rafael for finance signoff. If anyone thinks 40% is too aggressive, propose alternatives here. I can draft the memo once we agree the ask.

Thanks — Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive, Enterprise GTM
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: special pilot rate for Atlas Health — details + attachments

Thanks Steph — quick thoughts:
- 40% on published enterprise rate seems high given we usually cap at 30% for pilots unless there's a strong commit. What are the minimum conversion probabilities from ELT?
- Need clarity on whether Atlas is asking for a usage commitment or a strictly time-boxed pilot (your note says time-boxed, but the finance team will want protection).

Can we get Rafael in the thread and include a straightforward margin calc? If Rafael flags a problem, we should surface a counter: 30% with a $75k minimum commitment for the pilot term, or 40% with a $100k minimum and a cap at X tokens/month.

Also, I'm happy to own the internal memo draft if you want me to put it into the exception template.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Sales Operations
ben_carter@redwood.ai
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 08:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: special pilot rate for Atlas Health — details + attachments

Adding finance perspective after quick modelling (attached pilot-pricing-memo.xlsx):
- At 40% discount with no minimum commitment, expected margin for the pilot runs negative (~-6%) given our infra cost profile for high-token throughput.
- With a $100k minimum (6 months total), margin improves to ~12% which is borderline acceptable for a strategic reference but still tighter than our standard enterprise threshold (25%+).

Options:
1) Approve 40% discount + $100k pilot minimum + usage cap (recommended if leadership prioritizes the vertical play).
2) Approve 30% discount + $75k minimum + success-based uplift (e.g., an automatic 10% price step if conversion signed within 45 days).
3) Decline exception; offer standard EA pricing with a shorter trial credit.

I also recommend we require a PO that references the SOW and a short SLA appendix (availability and data handling). If leadership agrees to option 1, we need a signed exception memo addressed to VP and CFO for final signoff.

Rafael Mendes
VP, Finance & Revenue Operations
rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Attachment: pilot-pricing-memo.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 10:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: special pilot rate for Atlas Health — exception memo draft

Folks — I put together a short exception memo in our VP/CFO template (attached: exception-memo-for-vp-cfo.docx). Below is the executive summary I plan to include; please edit inline if you disagree.

Executive summary (proposed):
Redwood Sales requests authorization to offer Atlas Health a 40% discount to our standard enterprise per-unit rate for a 6-month pilot, contingent on a $100,000 pilot minimum and a usage cap of 1.5M tokens/month. The pilot is intended as a strategic healthcare reference and includes a conversion commitment window. Finance has modelled the economics and recommends the minimum to protect margin.

Key ask for VP/CFO: Approve the exception (Option 1) OR approve Option 2 as an alternative. If approved, routing instructions are: CFO signature on the attached memo and counterparty PO referencing the SOW.

Next steps I propose:
- Finalize memo language today (Marissa to own).
- Rafael to confirm final margin numbers are included in the memo appendix.
- Stephanie to set a 15-minute decision call with CFO + VP next week.

If no objections, I'll circulate the signed memo template for signatures and then generate a DocuSign envelope.

Marissa Cole
Head of Commercial Operations
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Attachment: exception-memo-for-vp-cfo.docx
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: special pilot rate for Atlas Health — final routing for signoff

Thanks everyone — this aligns. I've scheduled a 15-minute slot with CFO (tentative) for Wednesday 12/16 10:00 PT. I also confirmed with Atlas that the PO timeline can wait until after internal approval (they prefer DocuSign).

I've attached the SOW and pricing grid to the DocuSign envelope we will send after CFO signs. HubSpot deal ID is in related links for quick reference.

Please reply with final redlines by EOD today. If no redlines, Marissa, please route the memo for CFO signature and Rafael — include the margin appendix you referenced. We want the signed memo and DocuSign envelope to Atlas by EOD Thursday 12/17.

Elena (external) — looping you on internal next steps so you know the timeline; we'll share the signed memo and DocuSign link as soon as it's routed internally.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
